desc.zh: 董卓在京城为非作歹，王允寻觅合适人选欲再次执行除董大计。
desc.en: Dong Zhuo wreaks havoc in the capital. Wang Yun seeks a suitable person to execute the plan to eliminate Dong Zhuo once more.

if.zh: 玩家身份 != 君主
if.en: Player's rank != ruler

if.zh: 曹操不是玩家本人
if.en: Cao Cao is not the player

if.zh: 玩家势力 = 董卓 或 董卓：NPC势力已签订信义契约 = 是
if.en: Player's faction = Dong Zhuo or Dong Zhuo: the player belongs to their faction = yes

if.zh: 王允：NPC关系等级 >= 2
if.en: Wang Yun: relationship level >= 2

if.zh: 否则（非：董卓 / 李儒 / 吕布之一是玩家本人）
if.en: otherwise (not: one of Dong Zhuo / Li Ru / Lu Bu is the player)

desc.zh: 联军散去，朝廷迎来了数日安宁，然而最近朝中似乎又出现了奇怪的传闻...
desc.en: The coalition has disbanded, and the court enjoyed a few days of peace. Yet recently, strange rumors seem to have surfaced in the court once again...

if.zh: 董卓 / 李儒 / 吕布之一是玩家本人
if.en: one of Dong Zhuo / Li Ru / Lu Bu is the player

desc.zh: 大计已定，邀请吕布来赴宴，将貂蝉引荐给他。
desc.en: The grand plan is set. Invite Lu Bu to the banquet and introduce Diao Chan to him.

desc.zh: 前往曹操处，将王允的密信交给曹操，拜托其出兵引开吕布。
desc.en: Head to Cao Cao to deliver Wang Yun's secret letter and request that he deploy troops to lure away Lu Bu.

desc.zh: 前往曹操处，将王允的密信交给曹操，拜托其出兵引开吕布。
desc.en: Head to Cao Cao, deliver Wang Yun's secret letter to Cao Cao, and request that he deploy troops to lure away Lu Bu.

story.zh:
讨董联军散去，似乎已无人能阻挡董卓的暴行，但宫中仍有一名老臣还未放弃希望...

陈留可被占领（陈留不是己方势力城市，或不是其他势力下的唯一城市）。
story.en:
The coalition against Dong Zhuo has dispersed, and it seems none can halt his atrocities. Yet within the palace, an elder statesman has not given up hope...

Chenliu can be captured (Chenliu is not a city of your faction, or is not the only city under another faction).

trigger.zh: 王允、董卓、李儒、吕布、貂蝉、李傕存活。长安属董卓，李傕在董卓麾下，曹操未在董卓麾下。
trigger.en: Wang Yun, Dong Zhuo, Li Ru, Lu Bu, Diaochan, and Li Jue are alive. Changan belongs to Dong Zhuo, Li Jue serves under Dong Zhuo, Cao Cao does not serve under Dong Zhuo.

forbidden.zh: 主角为王允、貂蝉时无法触发。
forbidden.en: Cannot trigger if the protagonist is Wang Yun or Diaochan.

participate.zh: 【身属董卓势力】且【与王允关系等级至少为2级】，或【自身为董卓、李儒、吕布】
participate.en: 【Belong to Dong Zhuo's Faction】 and 【Relationship level with Wang Yun is at least Level 2】, or 【Play as Dong Zhuo, Li Ru, or Lu Bu】

defy.zh: 【<董卓>平定逆反并稳固权力】；【<董卓势力>使貂蝉成为家将】
defy.en: 【<Dong Zhuo> Suppress the rebellion and consolidate power】, 【<Dong Zhuo's Faction> Recruit Diaochan as a Retainer】

force.zh: 董卓身为君主并占领<长安>
force.en: Dong Zhuo is a Ruler and occupies <Chang'an>

force.zh: 王允、吕布、李儒、李傕回归董卓势力
force.en: Wang Yun, Lu Bu, Li Ru, and Li Jue return to Dong Zhuo's Faction
